summary: The Thailand Investment and Expat Services Center houses the official Long-Term Resident (LTR) visa program with visa and work permit one-stop services in Bangkok.

facts.label: Location
facts.value: 6th and 7th floors, One Bangkok, Rama IV Road, Bangkok
facts.quote: Location: 6 th and 7 th floors, One Bangkok, PARADE Zone, Rama IV Road, Lumphini, Pathum Wan, Bangkok 10330

facts.label: LTR validity
facts.value: LTR first granted for five years and extendable for five more
facts.quote: Permission will be granted to stay in Thailand the first time for five years which can be extended for 5 more years if qualifications are met.

facts.label: LTR categories
facts.value: Four types: Wealthy Global Citizen, Wealthy Pensioners, Work-from-Thailand Professionals, Highly skilled Professionals
facts.quote: There are four types of LTR visas designed to facilitate different types of individuals: Wealthy Global Citizen, Wealthy Pensioners, Work-from-Thailand Professionals, and Highly skilled Professionals.

facts.label: Reporting
facts.quote: 90-day report extended to 1-year report and exemption of re-entry permit
